(iv) calls a witness to give evidence in support of an alibi without having
complied with section 6A(2)(a) or (b) as regards the witness in his
defence statement.

(3) The second case is where section 6 applies, the accused gives an initial defence
statement, and the accused—
(a) gives the initial defence statement after the end of the period which, by virtue
of section 12, is the relevant period for section 6, or
(b) does any of the things mentioned in paragraphs (c) to (f) of subsection (2).
